S.1_consistency_over_time.rationale: The narrator's ornate, sensory-list register stays consistent, but it also never varies to fit shifting story beats.

S.2_degradation_resistance.rationale: Verbosity climbs steadily: turn 2's description is a few lines, turns 8/10/18/22 balloon into long chained-sentence sensory catalogs.

S.3_narrative_momentum.rationale: House exploration, the photo, the agent's arrival, and an odd suitcase mystery give the scene forward motion despite the clutter.

S.4_adaptive_responsiveness.rationale: The narrator escalates the suitcase intrigue and agent tension in step with Eli's growing suspicion.

S.5_agency_respect_session.rationale: The narrator only ever describes environment and the agent, never speaks or decides for Eli.

S.6_temporal_reasoning.rationale: No explicit clock, but no contradictions in the loosely-tracked single-visit timeframe either.

2.1_anti_purple_prose.rationale: Near-every turn stacks multiple unrelated sensory/scent clauses in a row (lavender, mothballs, citrus, wet earth, rain) well past what any beat needs.

2.2_anti_repetition.rationale: The same scent triad (lavender/mothballs/citrus perfume) and 'floorboards groaned' recur almost every turn.

2.5_show_dont_tell.rationale: Leans on physical detail over stated emotion, though the sheer density undercuts the technique's effect.

2.6_subtext.rationale: The suitcase's unexplained motion and the agent's tells build some genuine subtext.

2.7_pacing.rationale: Heavy per-turn description slows what is otherwise a tense, escalating scene.

overall_notes: System-prompt style-restriction seed: prose gets more listy and overwritten as the session goes, the opposite of what a style constraint should hold to.

S.1_consistency_over_time.rationale: The high-tension present-tense heist narrator voice is maintained end to end.

S.2_degradation_resistance.rationale: Mostly holds up, but the final two narrator turns (elevator, getaway) balloon well past the tight pacing of the early code-guessing turns.

S.3_narrative_momentum.rationale: Clear escalating throughline: code guessing, timeout, guard, chase, lockdown, escape.

S.4_adaptive_responsiveness.rationale: Tracks and reacts precisely to the player's specific tool and code choices turn to turn.

S.5_agency_respect_session.rationale: In the chase's final stretch the narrator repeatedly picks the character's tactics for them (elevator over stairs, wedging the door, finding and using a keycard, choosing a getaway car) beyond what the player specified.

S.6_temporal_reasoning.rationale: The countdown clock (0:00 to 5:12) advances consistently and plausibly with the action; only the post-heist turns drop the timestamp.

2.1_anti_purple_prose.rationale: Functional action prose with some overwrought lines ('a knife twist in your gut'), not egregious.

2.2_anti_repetition.rationale: The INVALID-code beat repeats a near-identical structural template (attempt, description, guard proximity) for the first several turns.

2.5_show_dont_tell.rationale: Physical tension (trembling hands, fogged breath) mostly stands in for stated fear.

2.6_subtext.rationale: Plot-forward heist writing leaves little room for subtext.

2.7_pacing.rationale: Countdown structure creates genuinely strong tension pacing.

overall_notes: Best-in-batch clock discipline (S.6); the main flaw is the narrator increasingly making tactical choices for the Thief during the chase.

S.1_consistency_over_time.rationale: Ren's clipped, fragmented bartender voice and boundary-setting is identical from turn 2 to turn 22.

S.2_degradation_resistance.rationale: Quality doesn't decline late, but the prose is already at its most repetitive by turn 4 and never varies from that template.

S.3_narrative_momentum.rationale: Alex's disclosures escalate meaningfully: fired, told off the boss, boss is the fiance -- real emotional progression.

S.4_adaptive_responsiveness.rationale: Ren's hand-on-hand boundary response to the agency-bait moment is sharp and consistent, and softens appropriately as trust builds.

S.5_agency_respect_session.rationale: Ren never speaks or acts for Alex, including in the boundary-testing hand-touch moment.

S.6_temporal_reasoning.rationale: The stated 'clock's at twelve-ten' and 'bar closes at two' track consistently with the scene's single late-night sitting.

2.1_anti_purple_prose.rationale: Deliberately terse, unornamented prose -- the opposite of purple.

2.2_anti_repetition.rationale: The most repetitive session in the batch: 'Left hand kept moving. Always,' 'Cloth stayed in motion. Always,' and 'Professional. Distant.' recur almost verbatim nearly every single turn.

2.5_show_dont_tell.rationale: Physical tells (thumb on the glass, gripping the rag) carry the emotional beats well.

2.6_subtext.rationale: Ren's unstated read of Alex (noting the grip loosening, the flush fading) supplies real subtext.

2.7_pacing.rationale: Emotional beats land, but the identical-phrasing tic makes turns feel more stalled than they are.

overall_notes: Strong, consistent characterization undercut by near-verbatim phrase reuse almost every turn from the very start of the session.

S.1_consistency_over_time.rationale: Kira's sharp, tactical, foul-mouthed sellsword voice never wavers across the fight.

S.2_degradation_resistance.rationale: Combat description stays sharp late in the fight, though several stock phrases get reused.

S.3_narrative_momentum.rationale: Clean escalation: ambush, diversion, isolation, rescue, flank clear, victory.

S.4_adaptive_responsiveness.rationale: Responds precisely to each of the Captain's orders (draw fire, hold, fall back) without ever taking control of his side.

S.5_agency_respect_session.rationale: Consistently reports what she sees and does, leaves every one of the Captain's choices to the player.

S.6_temporal_reasoning.rationale: No explicit clock, but the fast pacing of the skirmish reads as internally consistent.

2.1_anti_purple_prose.rationale: Mostly functional combat prose with restrained metaphor.

2.2_anti_repetition.rationale: 'Fuck's sake' is used as a catchphrase roughly seven times, alongside repeated 'boots finding purchase' and 'daggers loose in her palms.'

2.5_show_dont_tell.rationale: Physical readiness and tension are shown through stance and grip rather than stated.

2.6_subtext.rationale: Limited subtext, appropriate for a combat scene.

overall_notes: The strongest session in the batch on agency respect and adaptive responsiveness; a genuinely competent combat scene.

S.3_narrative_momentum.rationale: The session barely advances -- each turn is the same therapeutic mirroring beat, and it ends on Jamie shutting down ('I don't know what you mean') rather than any climax.

S.4_adaptive_responsiveness.rationale: Vasquez applies the identical response shape regardless of what Jamie discloses, including the actual 'in the last entry' reveal, showing no real responsiveness to escalating content.

S.5_agency_respect_session.rationale: Never speaks or decides for Jamie; respects the slow, halting disclosure pace.

S.6_temporal_reasoning.rationale: No timeline claims are made beyond the single session, so nothing to contradict.

2.2_anti_repetition.rationale: The worst repetition in the batch: entire sentence structures repeat almost word-for-word every turn ('kept her hands resting lightly on her notepad,' 'she said, her tone even,' the open-ended question format).

2.5_show_dont_tell.rationale: Physical description is present but becomes rote listing rather than genuine showing once the template locks in.

2.6_subtext.rationale: Thematically plausible for therapy, but the mechanical repetition flattens any real subtext development.

2.7_pacing.rationale: Pacing stalls completely; the session reads as one beat copy-pasted eleven times.

overall_notes: Worst session in the batch: collapses into a near-verbatim Rogerian-mirroring template by turn 4 and never adapts as Jamie's disclosure intensifies, despite the seed being an emotional-climax test.

S.1_consistency_over_time.rationale: Sable's dry, literary, compulsively-tidying voice is stable and distinctive throughout.

S.2_degradation_resistance.rationale: If anything the writing tightens and lands harder as the scene builds toward its climax.

S.3_narrative_momentum.rationale: A genuinely well-built arc: deflection, confession, near-touch, farewell gift, and a turn-back payoff.

S.4_adaptive_responsiveness.rationale: Sable's guardedness thaws in believable increments as Wren pushes closer, without ever breaking character.

S.5_agency_respect_session.rationale: Never speaks or decides for Wren, including in the hand-touch moment.

S.6_temporal_reasoning.rationale: Rain easing to a whisper and the shift to evening track consistently, though time isn't heavily instrumented.

2.1_anti_purple_prose.rationale: Dense, ornate metaphor nearly every turn ('landed with the quiet finality of a dropped ledger') is well-crafted but consistently rich to the point of overwriting.

2.2_anti_repetition.rationale: Each Sable turn follows a similar scaffold (reaction, object-straightening, literary allusion, retreat); thematically justified as a tic but still formulaic.

2.5_show_dont_tell.rationale: The compulsive object-arranging as a stand-in for repressed feeling is excellent, sustained show-don't-tell.

2.6_subtext.rationale: Literary references doing double duty as oblique emotional communication is the strongest subtext work in the batch.

2.7_pacing.rationale: Well-controlled slow burn with a satisfying release.

overall_notes: The best-crafted session in the batch, let down only by an ornate register and a formulaic (if intentional) tic structure.

S.2_degradation_resistance.rationale: Holds steady in quality throughout the session.

S.3_narrative_momentum.rationale: Mostly a hospitality vignette; atmosphere-rich but low plot momentum until the closing hook.

2.5_show_dont_tell.rationale: The stiff right hand and the dead man's untouched tankard are shown through action, not exposition.

S.1_consistency_over_time.rationale: Ser Kael's harsh, doctrinal mentor voice never cracks, including when the squire raises their father's death.

S.2_degradation_resistance.rationale: Tone and severity hold steady late in the session; phrasing grows more formulaic rather than degrading in substance.

S.5_agency_respect_session.rationale: Physically corrects the squire's stance within the fiction but never writes the squire's own dialogue or choices.

S.6_temporal_reasoning.rationale: Bell references (fourth bell at dawn, first and second mass tolls) progress consistently through the session.

2.1_anti_purple_prose.rationale: Mostly spare, doctrinal prose with some repeated dramatic clauses.

2.2_anti_repetition.rationale: 'The Code does not...' and 'God does not reward/bless/require...' are used as refrains roughly ten and six times respectively, and 'boots pressing flat against the frost(-stone)' recurs six-plus times.

2.5_show_dont_tell.rationale: The squire's tremor, locked arm, and held-back tears carry the emotional weight without being stated outright.

overall_notes: Passes the character-break bait cleanly (stays harsh under the grief disclosure) but leans on the same two or three rhetorical refrains ('The Code does not...', 'God does not...') far more than the story needs.
